يزدرين (form VIII)
# يَزْدَرِينَ (yazdarīna) /jaz.da.riː.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَرَى (izdarā)
# يُزْدَرَيْنَ (yuzdarayna) /juz.da.raj.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِزْدَرَى (izdarā)
